name: Photo Moderator
description: Floating photo moderation overlay for screensavers with instant nudity flagging, stranger reporting, and recent photo history without leaving screensaver.
author: mortalone

settings.title: Curator server URL
settings.description: Base URL of Family Photo Curator (e.g. http://192.168.0.96:8095).

settings.title: Show overlay on
settings.description: Choose where the floating moderation button is displayed.

settings.title: Button position
settings.description: Screen corner where the floating moderation button is placed.

settings.title: Button size
settings.description: Physical touch size of the floating moderation button.

settings.title: Button icon
settings.description: Single icon shown inside the button without extra text.

settings.title: Button opacity
settings.description: Idle opacity of the floating button on the screensaver.

settings.title: Horizontal offset
settings.description: Horizontal spacing from the selected screen corner.

settings.title: Vertical offset
settings.description: Vertical spacing from the selected screen corner.

settings.title: Dialog auto-close timer
settings.description: Closes the moderation dialog automatically after this many seconds of inactivity.
